patterns.note: The site alternates between massive, full-bleed media showcases and highly structured, multi-column editorial text layouts with generous whitespace.
Headings use a premium, high-contrast sans-serif with tight letter-spacing, often pairing a solid black primary phrase with a muted gray secondary action or subhead.
A strict neutral canvas of off-white, light gray, and deep black allows the vibrant, highly saturated colors of the portfolio case studies to command full attention.
The hero section features a high-speed, looping radial light-streak video that creates an immediate sense of momentum beneath a static, centered statement.
The 'All Work' page utilizes a dense, uniform 4-column grid of rounded square cards, some featuring interactive elements like red notification badges or pie-chart status overlays.

technique_notes: To recreate the hero experience, implement a full-bleed background video container playing a high-contrast, abstract motion loop, overlaid with a flex-centered typographic container and a floating, glassmorphic pill navigation bar that sticks to the top of the viewport on scroll.

For the project archive, build a CSS grid of aspect-ratio square cards with a subtle border-radius. Implement hover states that transition a semi-transparent, dark circular overlay (resembling a pie chart or clock) to indicate interaction depth, paired with minimal text labels positioned directly beneath each card.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, tight-leading headings (~4x body size) paired with clean, highly legible, medium-weight body copy and small, low-contrast metadata labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; square grid cards and floating header navigation use a defined medium border-radius, while case study hero images remain sharp and full-bleed.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and editorial, utilizing massive vertical margins to separate case study phases, contrasted with a dense, structured grid for the project index.

standout: The juxtaposition of an ultra-minimalist, high-contrast typographic layout with a dense, perfectly uniform square grid of project thumbnails featuring interactive status overlays like pie charts and notification badges.
